headline: Senior Web Developer | Frontend Engineer | Next.js, Accessibility, Fintech Funnels
summary: I have spent the last few years working for Bank of America Merrill Lynch as a front end developer on the marketing web team.  As part of this team I honed my development skills utilizing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, MVC, Node.js and the proprietary Sparta framework, which incorporates elements of Vue.js, to create pixel perfect webpages, landing pages and templates.   On the design side I continued to grow in my expertise with the Adobe Creative Suite, including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe InDesign.    I'm also an experienced illustrator having worked with a variety of mediums from acrylics to oils, painting digitally, and in my spare time I paint miniatures for commission.  I am very knowledgeable in regards to the design process and I'm capable of taking a concept from Ideation to completion using thumbnails, prototyping and comps.  I also have experience with heuristic evaluations and usability testing.  Most importantly I am a father of two beautiful daughters, and a United States Marine. experience.title: Senior Web Developer / Frontend Engineer
bullets: I'm a frontend engineer on the application development team, building the customer-facing loan funnels and the CMS and platform tooling behind them.  This year I rebuilt the loan offer experience as a single responsive screen. It has priority-sorted offer cards (Best, Better, Good) and fallback logic that keeps customers in the funnel even when they don't pick an offer. I also built custom partner-referral journeys that move approved customers straight into mobile phone verification. I modernized electronic income verification with bank routing validation and clearer error states. To let marketing work independently, I built code-defined global modals linked to CMS rich-text dropdowns, so disclosures can be updated without an engineering deploy.  On the quality side, I led our WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility effort, covering skip-link navigation, reduced-motion support, ARIA states, and screen-reader alerts. I also fixed canonical-origin conflicts across multi-domain funnels. I standardized automated testing with Playwright. I wrote the main architecture documentation for our Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle ORM stack so new teammates ramp up faster.  I work closely with QA to validate edge cases across complex offer combinations. I also partner with product and marketing to ship compliant legal disclosures and fast funnel iterations.

experience.title: Printing and Graphic Design
bullets: As a Marine stationed aboard Quantico, VA,  I reported in to the Command Visual Information Center.  As a junior Marine my job consisted of hands on print work, including copies, printing, mounting, laminating et cetera.  Progressing up to the Non-Commissioned officer I was placed in a leadership role and was responsible for ensuring our mission was accomplished.  I was in charge of up to eight individual junior Marines on any given day and would divvy out jobs, ensure quality control, and handle any customer situations that would arrive.  I spent a large portion of my overall time as a graphic designer for the Marine Corps creating retirement pamphlets, training manuals, informational collateral, posters, banners and a large assortment of other projects.  Also, with my background as an artist I was in a unique role where I actively created digital paintings for advertisements.  I also was privileged to work with the Commandant of the Marine Corps as well as the Sergeant Major of the Marine Corps painting and providing digital layout for christmas cards that were printed and mailed out to members of congress and other high ranking military professionals.
